summary_en: 2,700,000 shares (9.2% of S/O) to be acquired on 2026-08-31 via ToSTNeT-3 at close price; ¥5.813B cap; execution window 08:45 JST single session; partial or full non-execution possible per market conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via ToSTNeT-3 (Off-market Trading)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-28, Sanyo Shokai's board resolved to acquire up to 2,700,000 treasury shares (9.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum ¥5.813 billion via a single ToSTNeT-3 block trade scheduled for 2026-08-31 at 08:45 JST. Execution will occur at today's closing price (final special quotation included). The purchase order is valid only for that trading session; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. The acquisition supports the shareholder return enhancement policy announced on 2026-04-14 and aims to expand shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. Results will be disclosed after the trade closes on 2026-08-31.
